title: Explocen factory workers' continuing outdoor strike

continuity.summary: Outdoor strike starts after July2020 minimum-services process and persists to March2021 agreement; continuous prior-month episode, no new January event.

dates.summary: May30 declaration, June19 notice and July13 minimum-services order are not proven first physical strike day. March2021 agreement concerns strike settlement, not independently observed physical crowd departure. Exact physical end remains unknown;253-day duration not used to back-calculate.

state_target.summary: Workers demand state-linked employer rights; ISSFA military institute owns60%, ministries involved. State target to be finalized by owner.

participants.summary: 59 initial and52 retained participants refer strike history, not contemporaneous January simultaneous crowd.

state_response.summary: July and December police episodes including gas/beatings/arrest are prior events. January responses remain unknown; Jan11 virtual hearing is not a new public demonstration.

notes: Preserve prior July2020 ownership and outdoor continuity intoJanuary2021. Initial agent end2021-03 represented strike settlement; independent audit corrected physical end to null. Do not split by month or import December repression intoJanuary.
